description: This file defines the CartRepository class which manages shopping cart operations such as adding, updating, removing items, calculating total, and performing checkout via API. It interacts with data models like CartItem, OrderSummary, Product, and communicates with an external ApiService.

classes.name: CartRepository
classes.description: Repository class handling cart operations and checkout process, encapsulating cart state and API interactions.

methods.name: getCartItems
methods.description: Returns the current list of cart items.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart or increases its quantity.

methods.name: updateQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity for a product in the cart, removing it if quantity is zero or less.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart by its ID.

methods.name: totalCents
methods.description: Calculates the total price of cart items in cents.

methods.name: checkout
methods.description: Performs checkout via API, clears cart upon success, returns an OrderSummary.
